title: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina: cDNA End Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs the end prep for cDNA in the NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit. Reaction buffer and enzyme mix are added to samples before mixing. The sample plate is then moved to an off-deck thermocycler.
Temperature module cools down to 4 C

steps.title: Cool module to 4 °C
steps.instruction: Set the temperature module to 4 °C and allow it to reach the set point.

steps.title: Add reaction buffer and enzyme
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of the reaction buffer and enzyme mix to each sample well.

steps.title: Mix samples by pipetting
steps.instruction: Pipette the contents of each well to mix the added buffer and enzyme thoroughly.

steps.title: Move plate to thermocycler
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample plate from the OT‑2 deck to the off‑deck thermocycler for the end‑prep incubation.

steps.title: Protocol completion signal
steps.instruction: When the protocol finishes, the OT‑2 will flash to indicate completion.
